screen.lightspeed.startup_advice.launche:
For manual configuration, you can use these locations:
PCL2: Version Settings → Settings → Advanced Launch Options → JVM Arguments
HMCL: Instance/Version Settings → Java → JVM Arguments
Prism Launcher / MultiMC: Edit Instance → Settings → Java → Java Arguments
Official Launcher: Installations → Edit → More Options → JVM Arguments
